queue.topic: Kling 4.0 global launch (Oct 16 2026): native 30-second generation, 10 keyframes / 15 references, 2-minute extension, HDR + 21:9 coming, Kling 4.0 coming to Adobe Firefly
queue.caption:
FRAMEXGOD // AI NEWS — FXG-N006
AI × Film

Kling 4.0 is out. One prompt now runs a 30-second take.

Kling AI launched Kling 4.0 globally on October 16. The model generates 30-second clips natively and can extend an uploaded video up to two minutes. Omni Reference takes up to 10 keyframes and 15 reference assets across images, video and audio, and Kling says 10-bit HDR at 4K and a 21:9 format are coming. Adobe will bring Kling 4.0 to Firefly.

Stop prompting clips and start directing scenes. Thirty seconds is a scene, and camera moves and continuity now decide the result.

Follow @framexgod for AI × film news.

Source: Kling AI press release, Oct 16 2026.

FRAMEXGOD — Framexgod.com
